summary: Independent review of Jinshu 93 units s0001-s0037 (preface and Yang Xiu biography opening). The preface mentions (Fan Miqing, Dou Guangguo, Yin Xing, Shi Dan, Yang Jun, Jia Mi, Emperors Wu and Hui, Baosi, Yu Liang, Wang Gong, Chu Pou, Wang Yun, Jia Chong, Wang Xianzhi) are undated retrospective judgements but carry outside lifetime/reign windows; these are incorrect. Empress Dao's AD 300 appears borrowed from Min Huai. Yang Xiu's career dates are plausible but undated in the chapter and lack verified annal/conversion evidence, so they are research-blocked; several exact years overstate 'after'/累遷 sequences. Only Wang Gong's undated death (claim-82) is supported. No omitted births, deaths or ages were found in s0001-s0037 beyond these.

itemChecks.reason: Fan Miqing (Fan Hong) is praised as a model affine in the preface; the parenthetical 東漢光武之世 is not in the Chinese. The chapter preface (s0001-s0022) is the historian's later retrospective evaluation; it states no calendar date, so a lifetime/reign window is outside-sourced and describes a period, not this event.

findings.problem: Preface/kinship mentions carry outside lifetime, reign or career windows (and in some cases invented sourceDate text) that the Chinese does not state.
findings.action: Replace each with an undatedSourceAttestation (or add-reception-event classified retrospective where the mention is only the historian's later judgement); drop the invented windows and dependent hints.

findings.problem: 已入列傳 editorial notes are dated as life events.
findings.action: Remove the life-dated attestations and, if kept, add retrospective-reference events without life dates.

findings.problem: Preface allusions are given exact death years and literal places; Empress Dao's AD 300 appears borrowed from Min Huai.
findings.action: Research primary annals (Jinshu Hui di ji/Hou fei zhuan) with calendar conversion; treat 雲林/湖城 as allusions; until then mark unresolved.

findings.problem: Yang Xiu-biography dates are asserted from outside chronology without cited annals/conversion; some exact years overstate 'after' or 累遷 relations.
findings.action: Verify against Jinshu Wudi ji / Sanguozhi with a calendar converter (proleptic Gregorian); use onOrAfter bounds where the text gives only sequence.

findings.problem: Undated kinship/office/attitude statements receive invented years or period windows.
findings.action: Replace with undatedSourceAttestation values and remove dependent hints.

findings.problem: Active-date hints are synchronized to unsupported or unverified claim dates.
findings.action: Recompute hints after claim repairs; clear hints for people with only undated preface mentions.

findings.problem: p019 hint ends AD 283 from context death claim; s0037 thirteen-year tenure and sequence remain unanchored.
findings.action: Verify death year (context claim-151) and tenure start before keeping AD 263-283.

findings.problem: Person chronologies inherit the defective or unverified item dates above.
findings.action: Re-review persons after the item repairs and research are applied.
